ceil_reason: Mind2Web base-row-clustered 99% CI lower bound remains above 0.65 (0.6634), while the candidate-pair IID interval is recognized as anti-conservative; no CEIL status changes.
target_scope: ScreenSpot-Pro ui_type=text; apply OCR without a label-dependent runtime trigger and report recoverable/zero-coverage strata only as evaluation-side analyses.
confirmatory_requirements: regenerate OCR outputs in the confirmatory round
freeze one engine and one matcher/min-length/threshold before confirmatory outputs
include majority plus dev-selection as a required control
retain icon targets as a preregistered structural negative control
do not use row class or ground-truth overlap as a runtime gate
rationale: Across the full exploratory grid, both CPU OCR engines show substantial normalized/edit match coverage on recoverable and zero-coverage rows, and overall OCR-vs-pool error kappa remains roughly 0.10-0.20, below the 0.398 cross-family reference. The localization signal is concentrated on text targets (EasyOCR roughly 25-31% all-row accuracy; RapidOCR roughly 17-27%), while icon accuracy remains below 1.4%. This supports a narrowly scoped text-target confirmatory design, not a general OCR method. Full DOM/AX evaluation is deferred because the historically audited official dataset is currently missing locally, and Arm 3 shows that marginal accuracy/kappa alone do not identify a fusion policy without row-level calibrated evidence.
